Sunlenca (lenacapavir sodium) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline

GL-286218  
Guideline Name 
Sunlenca (lenacapavir sodium)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Community & State Arizona  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
7/1/2025  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Sunlenca  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - One of the following:  
 
 1.1 Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) documenting all of the following:  
 
  1.1.1 Diagnosis of HIV-1 infection  


--- PDF page 1622 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 1622 
 
AND 
 
  1.1.2 Both of the following:  
 
   1.1.2.1 Patient is heavily treatment-experienced with multidrug resistance as confirmed by a 
resistance assay 
 
AND 
 
   1.1.2.2 Patient is failing their current antiretroviral regimen due to ONE of the following: 
• 
Resistance  
• 
Intolerance  
• 
Safety considerations  
 
AND 
 
  1.1.3 Patient is currently taking, or will be prescribed, an active and optimized background 
antiretroviral therapy regimen  
 
AND 
 
  1.1.4 Prescribed by or in consultation with a clinician with HIV expertise  
 
OR 
 
 1.2 For continuation of prior therapy
